IMPORTANT: the Contact Us page names two direct contacts with obfuscated emails via the 'Anti-Spam by CleanTalk' WordPress plugin: Gregory Stone (Class Action Inquiries, phone 212-545-4774, on-page display 'Gs****@***fh.com') and Mark C. Rifkin (General Press Inquiries, phone 212-545-4600, on-page display 'ri****@***fh.com'). Unlike ordinary Cloudflare hex-encoded or HTML-entity-encoded emails, CleanTalk's scheme does not embed the real address anywhere in the static HTML -- decoding it requires the visitor's browser to complete a live, nonce-authenticated AJAX/REST call back to the firm's own server. That is a fundamentally different, active operation from decoding a static local cipher, so per the 'never construct, guess, or infer' rule this was deliberately NOT attempted, and the two addresses are left blank rather than reconstructed from the visible fragments (domain whafh.com + each local-part's first two letters). A human who wants either exact address should call the published phone number directly or open the live contact page in a real browser and click the link.
